propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh is a pure shell function mapping (CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) to a vote in {success, failure, cancelled} that must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point with identical behavior

The existing subprocess contract test in tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed to drive the Python entry point instead of the shell script, preserving its full case table and adding direct in-process unit tests
gerrit-verify.yaml must update its sparse-checkout path from 'scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh' to the new .py file (cone-mode: false) and update the run invocation to call the Python entry point
The Python entry point must implement fail-closed behavior: skipped+FAILURE_OBSERVED=true→failure, empty/unrecognized CONCLUSION→failure, and benign fallback skipped+FAILURE_OBSERVED=false→success
All direct and subprocess-driven unit tests must assert outputs are always in {success, failure, cancelled} with FAILURE_OBSERVED defaulting to false when unset
